row:
I am a massage therapist who helps other massage therapists. You help your clients all day. That's how I want to help you. I want to enable you to do what you love more effectively, so you can love this work for longer, and feel better while we do it. 

I teach continuing education classes for massage therapists around the country, in person and online. Let's get better together.
